finding.title: Runtime node membership is outside the causal S1 snapshot identity and NODE_RESULT source membership is not authenticated at coordinator admission

evidence.observation: runtime_register_node INSERT OR REPLACEs the nodes table but does not bump meta.epoch.
state_digest is computed from epoch, generation, tasks, scopes and leases; nodes/membership/health are omitted.

RESULT_SCHEMA validates source_kind, packet digest, lease/CAS/generation and duplicate status but does not require packet.source_node_id to exist in nodes or be healthy/runtime-admitted before INSERT into admitted_results.
source_node_id is derived from the caller-supplied --node argument; the child does not read/authenticate the nodes table before producing NODE_RESULT/v1.

preconditions: A valid scoped coordinator lease/token exists.
A current exact snapshot identity exists.
No node named ghost is required to exist in the nodes registry.
construction: Use the valid coordinator lease/token and exact current expected_epoch/expected_digest.
The ExactSnapshotFabric wrapper checks generation/epoch/digest but does not authenticate source membership.
The inherited Fabric.coordinator_commit accepts the packet schema/source_kind/digest and inserts packet.source_node_id into admitted_results without a nodes-table membership check.

why_it_matters: The architecture claims deterministic runtime/fabric authority for membership, but membership is not part of the replay/state identity used by node observations.
A packet can claim a source_node_id that is not demonstrably the runtime-admitted process/node that produced the payload.
Because runtime_register_node does not advance epoch and nodes are omitted from state_digest, membership changes can occur without changing the causal snapshot identity seen by ordinary nodes.
Physical GRID10 PID overlap proves ten OS processes existed, but by itself does not close runtime membership/source-authentication provenance for later NODE_RESULT admission.

counterhypothesis.claim: The harness controls --node values and pre-registers x01..x10, so explicit membership authentication is unnecessary for the bounded happy-path fixture.
counterhypothesis.response: That may preserve a narrow fixture demonstration, but it does not justify a general physical GRID10/result-flow or causal-source provenance claim. Promotion must either narrow the claim to trusted-harness-controlled identity or add a deterministic membership/source-authentication gate.

cheapest_high_information_discriminator.name: UNREGISTERED_SOURCE_NEGATIVE
steps: Add a negative test using an exact-current NODE_RESULT/v1 whose source_node_id is an unregistered ghost node.
Require fail-closed RESULT_SOURCE_NODE_UNREGISTERED before admitted_results mutation.
Add a second negative for a registered-but-unhealthy node and require RESULT_SOURCE_NODE_UNHEALTHY unless an explicit historical-result policy is separately defined.

Bind node membership/health or an immutable membership admission identity into the observation/provenance envelope; do not silently overload state_digest if membership is intentionally a distinct deterministic authority domain.
If membership remains outside S1 digest by design, add a separate membership_generation/admission_id and bind it into NODE_RESULT plus coordinator admission.

recommended_design_direction.reason: Typed Entry/causal provenance law favors explicit authority identities. A dedicated membership_generation or admission_id avoids conflating cognitive S1 content with runtime membership while still making source authority replay-stable and fail-closed.
minimum_patch: Authenticate RESULT_SCHEMA source_node_id against deterministic nodes authority at commit.
Reject missing/unhealthy source identities according to an explicit policy.
Make membership changes causally visible through epoch/digest or a distinct monotonic membership identity bound into the packet.

next_exact_gate: Implement and execute UNREGISTERED_SOURCE_NEGATIVE plus membership-causal-identity binding at exact current source identity before promoting physical GRID10 result-flow provenance.
